# Security Policy

Report vulnerabilities privately with [GitHub's vulnerability reporting form](https://github.com/Drippyz1/sentinel/security/advisories/new) when available. Do not include exploit details, credentials, or personal data in a public issue. If private reporting is unavailable, open an issue requesting a private contact method without describing the vulnerability.

Include the affected version, OS and architecture, affected component, impact, and steps to verify the issue. Test against your own device and data. Redact process arguments, hostnames, local addresses, and paths from evidence. Active maintenance is focused on the current source and latest release line; older versions do not receive routine backports.
